description.value:
Frequency —

Requirement You are wielding your named weapon.

Choose one weapon at the time you take this feat; renaming it takes a week of downtime and a good reason. While wielding it, The Answer also triggers when a foe within your reach Steps away from you, in addition to its usual trigger. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the damage roll of an Answer made with that weapon.

cinderfall.incomplete: The trigger-extension (The Answer also fires on a Step-away) needs no rule element, ships unencoded like the rest of this class's trigger-widening cards. The ChoiceSet + item:id:{item|flags.system.rulesSelections.<flag>} predicate form for "wielding the specific chosen weapon" is confirmed real via pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/gleaming-blade.json's own existingIkon selection.
